title: Customer Profile (Long-Term Memory)
description: Persistent customer profile stored in external database with consent, GDPR Article 9 compliance, and encryption.

preferred_name.description: First name or nickname (mutable; updatable by customer)

legal_name.description: Full legal name (optional; for order receipts/refunds)

severity.description: Customer-reported severity (informational only; never used to declare safe)

version.description: Version number (immutable history; version 1 at creation, version++ on updates)

created_at.description: When this allergen record was created (immutable)

updated_at.description: When this allergen record was last updated (null if never updated)

allergies.description: GDPR Article 9 health data; requires explicit consent + encryption

past_orders.description: Order history (limited to last 12 months by default; full 3-year retention for tax/legal)

address_id.description: Reference ID to secure address store (NEVER inline full address)

default_delivery.description: Default delivery address (reference ID only; full address in secure store)

store_profile.description: Consent to store name, contact info, favorites

store_allergies.description: GDPR Article 9 explicit consent for health data storage

policy_version.description: Privacy policy version at time of consent (e.g., '1.2')

ip_address.description: IP address at consent capture (for audit trail; may be redacted)

consent.description: Consent record (versioned; new record on consent update)

ttl_days.description: Time-to-live for this profile (12 months default)

inactivity_threshold_days.description: Auto-delete if no activity for 3 months

last_activity.description: Timestamp of last order or profile access

deletion_requested.description: If customer requested deletion, timestamp of request

last_access.description: Last time agent accessed this profile

modification_log.description: Immutable audit trail of all modifications

immutability_rules.customer_id: Immutable; generated at creation, never changes
immutability_rules.allergies: Immutable history; create new allergen_record on update (version++), never patch old record
immutability_rules.consent: New consent record created on opt-in/opt-out changes; old consent preserved in audit log
immutability_rules.audit: Append-only log; never delete or modify audit entries

encryption_requirements.at_rest: CMK (customer-managed keys) in Standard setup; Microsoft-managed in Basic
encryption_requirements.access_control: Customer self-service (read own profile, request deletion); support agents with RBAC; audit log required

compliance_notes.gdpr_article_9: Health data (allergies) requires explicit consent AND lawful basis (consent captured in 'consent.store_allergies')
compliance_notes.cpra: Allergies classified as 'sensitive personal information'; opt-in only; limit-use notice required
compliance_notes.access_rights: Customer can view full profile; delete profile (hard delete within 30 days)
compliance_notes.data_minimization: Never store credit card numbers, CVV, passwords, or precise location (use address reference ID)
compliance_notes.retention: TTL 12 months of inactivity; order history retained 3 years for tax/legal; audit logs 90 days
